name: Supabase
one_liner: Postgres backend platform with database, auth, storage, realtime and edge functions.
auth_notes: Management API takes a bearer access token: a personal access token with custom expiry, or OAuth2 to act on a user's behalf. OAuth2 flow type is not stated on the fetched pages.
access_notes: Personal access tokens are generated from the account page. OAuth2 requires building a Supabase integration. Cost is not stated on the fetched pages beyond a general pricing statement.

buildability.rationale: Management API is documented with PAT and OAuth2 bearer auth and rate limits. Tier and cost are not stated on fetched pages, and the per-project PostgREST data API docs are absent.

identity.quote: Learn how to get up and running with Supabase through tutorials, APIs and platform resources.

auth.quote: All API requests require an access token to be included in the Authorization header:
OAuth2 allows your application to generate tokens on behalf of a Supabase user, providing secure and limited access

access.quote: To generate or manage your personal access tokens, visit your account page.
All resources created via the API are subject to the pricing detailed on our Pricing pages.

api_surface.quote: POST /v1/projects is organization-scoped, using the organization_slug in the request body.
Rate limits are applied to prevent abuse and ensure fair usage of the Management API.

mcp.quote: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes how Large Language Models (LLMs) talk to external services like Supabase.

buildability.quote: The Management API is subject to our fair-use policy.

needs_human_reason: Cost and tier for API access are not on the fetched pages. The per-project PostgREST data API is not covered by these pages, so the Management API vs per-project ambiguity is unresolved.
